name: bi-platform
description: Self-Service BI & Data Analytics Platform — script điều phối cho backend + frontend

scripts.lint: npm --workspace shared run lint && npm --workspace backend run lint && npm --workspace frontend run lint
scripts.lint:fix: npm --workspace shared run lint:fix && npm --workspace backend run lint:fix && npm --workspace frontend run lint:fix
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace backend run typecheck && npm --workspace frontend run typecheck
scripts.format: npm --workspace shared run format && npm --workspace backend run format && npm --workspace frontend run format
scripts.format:check: npm --workspace shared run format:check && npm --workspace backend run format:check && npm --workspace frontend run format:check
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace backend run build && npm --workspace frontend run build
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace backend run test && npm --workspace frontend run test
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace backend run test:integration
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.infra:up:all: docker compose -f infrastructure/docker-compose.yml --profile data --profile bi --profile stream --profile tools up -d
scripts.infra:down: docker compose -f infrastructure/docker-compose.yml --profile data --profile bi --profile stream --profile tools down
scripts.infra:down:extra: docker compose -f infrastructure/docker-compose.yml --profile data --profile bi --profile stream --profile tools rm -sf minio minio-init clickhouse cube kafka connect dbt
scripts.infra:ps: docker compose -f infrastructure/docker-compose.yml --profile data --profile bi --profile stream --profile tools ps
